tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile, time
p = Path('pipeline/workflow.go')
replacements = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
    'StampEvent': 'AnnotateEvent',
    'CountItems': 'TallyItems',
    'MergeParts': 'CombineParts',
    'FilterNoise': 'PruneNoise',
    'SortRecords': 'OrderRecords',
    'EncodePayload': 'MarshalPayload',
    'DecodeReply': 'ParseReply',
    'OpenChannel': 'ConnectChannel',
    'CloseChannel': 'ReleaseChannel',
    'FlushBuffer': 'DrainBuffer',
    'SaveResult': 'PersistResult',
}
data = p.read_bytes()
for old, new in replacements.items():
    data = data.replace(old.encode(), new.encode())
st = p.stat()
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=p.parent, delete=False) as f:
    temp = Path(f.name)
    f.write(data)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.chmod(temp, st.st_mode)
os.replace(temp, p)
now = time.time_ns()
os.utime(p, ns=(max(st.st_atime_ns, now), max(st.st_mtime_ns + 1, now)))
PY

gofmt -w pipeline/workflow.go
git diff -- pipeline/workflow.go"
